verdict.rationale: Vercel's git-integrated deploys provide implicit versioning (every push creates a new deployment/preview), rollback lets you revert production to a prior deployment without rebuild, and preview comments/Vercel Agent code review provide review capability — all of which would cover automations (e.g. Workflows SDK code) since they ship as part of a deployment. However, there is no automation-specific versioning/audit trail or rollback UI distinct from general deployment rollback, and no evidence of granular per-workflow version history or diffing. Missing for 10: dedicated automation/workflow version history separate from deployment versioning, workflow-specific rollback tooling, and independent hands-on confirmation of rolling back a running automation mid-execution.
